Democrats Nominate Hakeem Jeffries for House Speaker, Making History

Democrats have nominated Hakeem Jeffries to be Speaker of the House, a move that could make him the first Black person to hold the position. The nomination by House Democrats positions Jeffries to potentially make history. Some Democrats reportedly voted against the nomination.
